title: 第653章 救还是不救第652章 走不掉了
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
云星落当即开口：“不用慌，转机来了，前来寻求唤醒镇族至宝的各大古族强者，已经抵达附近，最近的一族，距离我们不足二十公里！”
“我们先撤离这里，远离神族山门，避开他们的埋伏绝杀圈，等各路古族强者赶到，一切都好办了。”
“退！”
三人没有丝毫犹豫，立刻点头应令。
四人身形一闪，齐齐御剑腾空，迅速后撤五公里，悬浮于高空虚空之上，静静蛰伏等候。
神族废墟深处，埋伏已久的巫族、雷族众人，看云星落等人已经到了山门，瞬间掉头又走了，瞬间全员愣住。
他们精心布下天罗地网，掏空心思埋伏许久，就是想引诱四人踏入废墟，利用地利与阵法，悄无声息围杀，不留半点痕迹。
可谁曾想，他们连山门都不进。
巫族大长老巫山眉头紧锁，忍不住开口问道：“族长，他们不肯入瓮，怎么办？”
巫族族长巫翎立在废墟之巅，一身黑袍无风自动，面容冷冽至极，眼底满是阴寒戾气。
“该死！”她低声冷喝，“我们倒是忘了，神族覆灭已有十余年，外界的人还不道，他们前来看到如此废墟，一定以为是我们做的，惊恐之下逃离了。”
巫山急道：“他们竟然被吓跑了？我们要不要追上去截杀？”
话音未落，一旁的雷族族长雷霸天猛地踏出一步。
他周身雷光炸响，霸道蛮横，满脸不屑与狂傲，早已失去所有耐心。
“瞧你们小心翼翼的，还商量个鸟。”雷霸天冷声怒吼，“此地本就是我上古古族的地界，我们何须藏头露尾、玩这些阴诡伎俩！”
“那小丫头身上握着我雷族与巫族两大镇族至宝，区区四名化神蝼蚁罢了。我们两大族长亲至，随便一人出手，便能碾杀他们，直接硬抢便是！”
周围两族长老、弟子纷纷附和：“雷族长说得对，我们的地盘我们做主，何须藏头露尾的。”
巫翎眼底寒光暴涨，她也没有了耐心：“说得没错，是我过于讲究了，走，动手！”
蛰伏在废墟中的二十多名巫族、雷族强者，瞬间齐齐腾空而起。
嗡！

二十多道入圣境、化神强者齐出，恐怖的威压瞬间席卷天地，整片虚空都剧烈震颤。
他们不再隐匿身形，不再遮掩杀机，速度快到极致，化作一道道流光，朝着五公里外的云星落四人疯狂追杀而去。
破空之声刺耳轰鸣，杀意铺天盖地，笼罩四方。
虚空之上，正在等候的云星落四人瞬间感知到身后恐怖的追杀气息袭来。
霍小棠脸色瞬间发白：“他们追来了，好恐怖，要不要逃？”
叶凌霜全身灵力紧绷，已然做好逃遁的准备。
云星落面色彻底冰冷，嘴角浮现出一抹嘲讽：“一群不要脸的，终于不装了，既然如此，开始我们的计划。”
云星落瞬间开启异瞳，眸光穿透长空，飞速扫视四方。
她的目光落在不远处的一支队伍上，那是一名白发老者，带着五名化神弟子，正疾驰而来。
云星落通过鸿蒙天机盘得知，他们是神符一族的强者，也是所有古氏族当中最强者。
“七玄！”云星落沉声低喝，“左前方，一群白袍之人。”
content_en:
Yun Xingluo immediately said: "Don't panic, the turning point is here. The powerful ancient clans who came to seek the treasure to awaken the clan have arrived nearby. The nearest clan is less than 20 kilometers away from us!"
"Let's evacuate here first, stay away from the mountain gate of the God Clan, and avoid their ambush and killing circle. When the powerful ancient tribes arrive, everything will be easy to handle."
"Retreat!"
The three of them nodded immediately and responded to the order without any hesitation.
The four people flashed, and all took to the air with their swords. They quickly retreated five kilometers, suspended high in the sky, and waited quietly.
Deep in the ruins of the God Clan, the people from the Wu Clan and the Thunder Clan, who had been lying in wait for a long time, saw that Yun Xingluo and others had arrived at the mountain gate. They turned around and left again, and everyone was stunned.
They carefully set up a dragnet and lay in wait for a long time, just to lure the four of them into the ruins. They took advantage of the favorable location and formation to kill them quietly without leaving any trace.
But who would have thought that they wouldn't even enter the mountain gate.
Wu Shan, the chief elder of the Wu clan, frowned and couldn't help but ask: "Clan leader, what should I do if they refuse to enter the urn?"
The leader of the Wu Clan, Wu Ling, stood on the top of the ruins. He was dressed in a black robe without any wind, his face was extremely cold, and his eyes were full of cold and vicious aura.
"Damn it!" She shouted coldly in a low voice, "We have forgotten that it has been more than ten years since the destruction of the Protoss. People from the outside world still don't know. When they came to see such ruins, they must have thought that it was us who did it, and fled in panic."
Wu Shan asked anxiously: "They were scared away? Should we catch up and intercept them?"
Before he finished speaking, the leader of the Thunder Clan, Lei Batian, took a sudden step forward.
Thunder exploded all around him, he was domineering and arrogant, his face was full of disdain and arrogance, and he had already lost all patience.
"Look at how cautious you are, and you're still talking about nothing." Lei Batian roared coldly, "This place is the territory of my ancient tribe, why do we need to hide our heads and show our tails and play these underhanded tricks!"
"That little girl is holding the two most valuable treasures of my Thunder Clan and Wu Clan, and they are just four god-transforming ants. Our two clan leaders are here in person, and any one of them can crush them and kill them, just grab them head-on!"
The elders and disciples of the two surrounding tribes all agreed: "Chief Lei is right, we have the final say on our territory, so there is no need to hide one's head and show one's tail."
The cold light in Wu Ling's eyes rose sharply, and she lost her patience: "You're right, I'm too particular, let's go, do it!"
More than twenty strong men from the Witch Clan and Thunder Clan who were dormant in the ruins instantly jumped into the air.
Buzz!
More than twenty powerful men who had entered the holy realm and transformed into gods all came out. The terrifying pressure swept across the world in an instant, and the entire void trembled violently.
They no longer concealed their figures or concealed their murderous intentions. Their speed reached an extreme level, turning into streaks of light and frantically chasing the four Yun Xingluo people five kilometers away.
The sound of piercing the sky was harsh and roaring, and the killing intent was overwhelming, covering all directions.
Above the void, the waiting Yun Xingluo and the four others instantly sensed the terrifying pursuit aura coming from behind them.
Huo Xiaotang's face turned pale instantly: "They are chasing me. It's so scary. Do you want to run away?"
Ye Lingshuang's whole body's spiritual power was tense and she was ready to escape.
Yun Xingluo's face was completely cold, and a trace of ridicule appeared on the corner of his mouth: "A group of shameless people finally stopped pretending. In this case, let's start our plan."
Yun Xingluo instantly opened his special pupils, his eyes penetrated the sky, and quickly scanned all directions.
Her eyes fell on a team not far away. It was a white-haired old man who was galloping over with five disciples of God Transformation.
Yun Xingluo learned from the Hongmeng Tianji Pan that they were the strongest members of the Divine Rune Clan and the strongest among all the ancient clans.
"Qixuan!" Yun Xingluo shouted in a low voice, "In the front left, there is a group of people in white robes."
